about: Reviewed App test ownership for scripts/app_test_plan.py (TAL-2390). A rule narrows a production change to its tests only while its files declare nothing other files reach without naming it, and only its listed consumers and tests reference what it declares; the planner checks both on every run and runs the affected targets in full when either fails. Add a rule only after reading every consumer and the tests that cover it. A reader maps test resources to the Swift file that loads them.

rules.name: markdown-math-formatter
rules.review: The formatter reaches the App through two consumers. MarkdownMathSegmenter calls mayContainMath and replacingInlineMath for every message and feeds MarkdownMathLayoutCache; the package renderer, formatting-budget and layout-cache tests drive both through the segmenter. DisplayMathView falls back to renderedText for LaTeX SwiftMath cannot parse. Inline math reaches the App as InlineMathReference images: ChatMessageLinkRegions draws a paragraph holding them through DisplayMathView's InlineMathParagraphText and TranscriptMediaContentView's inline image provider draws them in headings and table cells; the hosted MarkdownMathRendererTests render both.
